nodes.label: Parallel Agent Reliability Query
nodes.rationale: Three blind runs are a useful smoke test, but replacement decisions require adjudicated truth, inter-run consistency, grounded evidence, false-resolved rates, time, and cost.

nodes.label: Deterministic External Guards
nodes.rationale: The proposed production boundary verifies literal evidence, derived arithmetic, catalog allow/deny rules, inter-run disagreement, strict versioned JSON, and a DB-backed 27/27 barrier outside the model.

nodes.label: Isolated Codex Runner Service
nodes.rationale: A separate HTTP job runner isolates long Codex executions from n8n, limits filesystem and database authority, validates schema, and exposes queued and completed job states.

nodes.label: Codex Shadow Mode Evaluation
nodes.rationale: The proposed safe transition runs Codex independently beside the existing workflow, compares both with adjudicated truth, and keeps the old result authoritative until repeated evidence justifies switching.

nodes.label: Application Documents Completeness Contract
nodes.rationale: Field 27 requires complete retrieval of mandatory and conditional application materials before generating a concise presentation value, with conditions retained when omission would mislead.

nodes.label: Literal License Certificate Boundary
nodes.rationale: Field 22 admits only documents explicitly called a license or certificate and excludes permissions, registrations, passports, declarations, and participant registry extracts unless separately represented in application_documents.

nodes.label: Round 2 Fail Closed Route Guard
nodes.rationale: Only four field keys have field-specific Round 2 semantic rules; the other 23 must terminate as requires_review with audit and evidence preserved instead of using a generic resolver.

nodes.label: Four Run Reproducibility Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Four independent analyses used byte-identical source materials; every run returned 27 fields, while only 22 of 27 field statuses were unanimous.

nodes.label: Exec Run Completion Summary
nodes.rationale: The exec run reports all 12 documents and formats checked, with 21 resolved, 4 requires_review, and 2 not_found fields.

nodes.label: Exec Blind Analysis Result
nodes.rationale: The exec result completed the structural contract but over-escalated customer_contacts and participation_cost and resolved national_regime despite recording contradictory Russian-origin requirements.

nodes.label: Run 1 Blind Analysis Result
nodes.rationale: Run 1 preserved the national-regime conflict and used not_found for participation cost, but miscalculated the procurement quantity as 10 instead of 11 and used less precise quotations.

nodes.label: Run 1 Reproducible Analysis Process
nodes.rationale: The log records corpus inventory, OOXML extraction, PDF rendering and visual review, temporary analysis scripts, report writing, and a final automated 27-field structure check.

nodes.label: Run 2 Blind Analysis Result
nodes.rationale: Run 2 was the safest single result, with detailed structural locators and preserved conflicts, but over-escalated participation cost and still violated the field-22 boundary.

nodes.label: Run 2 Reproducible Analysis Process
nodes.rationale: The log records full DOCX and PDF analysis, ActiveX inspection, a user correction forbidding Graphify, and final validation of 27 results with a 21/4/2 status distribution.

nodes.label: Run 3 Blind Analysis Result
nodes.rationale: Run 3 correctly derived 11 units and inspected embedded XLSX and graphical controls, but resolved national_regime and application_documents even while describing their contradictions.

nodes.label: Run 3 Reproducible Analysis Process
nodes.rationale: The log records complete format inventory, full OOXML and embedded-object extraction, visual review of both PDFs, and an automated verification of 27 ordered fields and required evidence attributes.

nodes.label: Shared Licenses and Certificates Drift
nodes.rationale: All four runs widened licenses_certificates beyond documents literally named licenses or certificates, proving that majority voting cannot reveal correlated semantic errors.

nodes.label: Unresolved Conflict Guard
nodes.rationale: A field must not be resolved when its own rationale still records a material contradiction; national_regime and application_documents exposed this failure class.

nodes.label: Single Agent FINAL Acceptance Risk
nodes.rationale: All runs satisfied the 27-field shape, but random errors and shared semantic drift make one unreviewed agent run unsafe as production FINAL.

nodes.label: Client Semantics Safety Invariants
nodes.rationale: Confirmed presentation choices do not authorize inference from absence or relaxation of evidence and route guards.

nodes.label: not_found Semantic Rule
nodes.rationale: Unknown after full analysis must remain distinct from a directly evidenced negative answer.

nodes.label: Composite Run Document Unit Integrity
nodes.rationale: Composite foreign keys prevent units and facts from being attached across analysis runs.

nodes.label: Round 2 Is Terminal
nodes.rationale: Forbidding recursive recheck prevents an unbounded semantic loop.

nodes.label: Report Does Not Reinterpret FINAL
nodes.rationale: Presentation may shorten confirmed content but cannot change status, add facts, or replace evidence.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Synchronization Layer
nodes.rationale: Independent conditional branches may never execute, so durable completion barriers cannot depend on Merge or in-memory item collection.

nodes.label: Unified FINAL Contract Decision
nodes.rationale: Every terminal field path needs the same versioned shape regardless of whether resolution came from facts, metadata, or recheck.

nodes.label: Postgres State Machine Decision
nodes.rationale: Separate one-document executions improve retry, concurrency, and failure isolation compared with a single long loop.

nodes.label: Layered AI Validation
nodes.rationale: The system does not trust one model pass; deterministic evidence validation and an independent validator constrain extracted facts.

nodes.label: Gotenberg Operational Isolation
nodes.rationale: A separate Compose project permits install and rollback without recreating the production n8n stack.

nodes.label: Safe Recursive Archive Extraction
nodes.rationale: Path checks, bounded recursion, size limits, and isolated storage protect the server and prevent partial document sets.

nodes.label: PDF Derived from Exact HTML
nodes.rationale: PDF conversion must not regenerate or reinterpret the already validated report content.

nodes.label: Bankruptcy Tax and Enforcement Debt Checks
nodes.norm_label: bankruptcy tax and enforcement debt checks

nodes.label: Atomic Document Claim
nodes.rationale: A conditional PostgreSQL transition prevents two workers from processing the same document concurrently.

nodes.label: Live Orchestrator Reconciliation
nodes.rationale: The production candidate must be based on the live production Worker target because the local export points to a test Worker.

nodes.label: Company Matching Out of Scope
nodes.rationale: The MVP focuses on trustworthy extraction of procurement fields before judging supplier fit.

nodes.label: Workflow JSON as Executable Prompt Source
nodes.norm_label: workflow json as executable prompt source

nodes.label: Document Worker Extractor Request Builder v2.1
nodes.norm_label: document worker extractor request builder v2.1

nodes.label: Exact Grounded Evidence Rules
nodes.rationale: Facts must be auditable against continuous verbatim quotes from supplied semantic blocks, so metadata and model inference cannot become evidence.

nodes.label: No Global Not Found in Extractor
nodes.norm_label: no global not found in extractor
nodes.rationale: A single analysis unit cannot establish absence across the entire procurement, so the extractor returns an empty facts array instead of not_found.

nodes.label: Field-Specific Semantic Exclusions
nodes.rationale: Each field profile separates confirmation criteria from semantic exclusions and review conditions to prevent nearby but incorrect tender concepts from being accepted.

nodes.label: Absence Is Not a Negative Fact
nodes.norm_label: absence is not a negative fact
nodes.rationale: not_found means reliable determination failed after full analysis and recheck; it never proves no, false, or not required.

nodes.label: Fail-Closed Archive Preparation
nodes.rationale: One archive failure aborts the run before workers start so missing documents cannot produce false not_found results.

nodes.label: Graphify Instructions Absence Query
nodes.rationale: The saved query found project operating and source-of-truth rules in AGENTS.md but no repository-specific Graphify instruction at that time.

nodes.label: Agent Instruction Provenance Query
nodes.rationale: The saved query marked the existing graph as non-authoritative because it lacked current runner instruction files and therefore required direct branch-source inspection.

nodes.label: Blind Tender Analysis Protocol
nodes.rationale: The shared protocol requires full-document review, visual scan inspection, OOXML control-state inspection, exactly 27 fields, grounded quotes, explicit conflicts, and safe not_found semantics.

nodes.label: tender_fields_v1 Semantic Catalog
nodes.rationale: The catalog is the human-readable semantic source of truth for exactly 27 stable field_key values across worker, aggregation, recheck, finalization, and reporting layers.

nodes.label: Safe not_found Semantics
nodes.rationale: not_found means a value could not be established after complete analysis and never implies no, not required, not applicable, or not provided.

nodes.label: Minimal Change Discipline
nodes.rationale: Reliability, reproducibility, audit preservation, and avoiding silent failures take priority over broad redesign.

nodes.label: Source of Truth Priority
nodes.rationale: Conflicts must be disclosed and resolved by preferring live state or canonical implementation over secondary documentation.

nodes.label: Majority Vote Shared-Error Limit
nodes.rationale: Agreement among similar models does not protect against a systematic semantic mistake shared by all of them.

nodes.label: Initial Maximum Price 3,181,278.10 RUB with VAT
nodes.norm_label: initial maximum price 3,181,278.10 rub with vat

nodes.label: Owner PDF Visual Acceptance
nodes.rationale: The 153-page A4 artifact received owner visual acceptance, explicitly not an independent exhaustive page-by-page Codex audit.

nodes.label: PDF Signature Validation Gate
nodes.rationale: Execution 14650 proved that nominal application/pdf metadata cannot silently pass when the payload lacks the %PDF- signature.

nodes.label: Verified HTML to PDF Runtime Path
nodes.norm_label: verified html to pdf runtime path
nodes.rationale: Execution 14649 converted the exact 598452-byte report HTML through Gotenberg into a validated 909642-byte PDF while preserving both binaries.

nodes.label: Readable PDF Filename Persistence
nodes.rationale: After validating the original Gotenberg bytes, the workflow re-persists them with prepareBinaryData so the terminal filesystem-v2 object and browser download carry the readable report filename.

nodes.label: Two Part Advance Contract Guarantee
nodes.rationale: Field 20 must separately cover contract-performance security and advance-return security within one stable field_key; evidence for one part cannot silently close the other.

nodes.label: Whole Corpus Agent Reviewer Advantage
nodes.rationale: A whole-corpus agent can revisit sources, compare fields, inspect conflicts, and check completeness, whereas narrow workflow model calls see filtered units or candidates.

nodes.label: Early Context Loss Failure
nodes.rationale: Once an upstream worker detaches a value from its heading or assigns the wrong field_key, later validator and aggregator stages cannot reliably reconstruct the missing context.

nodes.label: Codex Agentic Blind Test Package
nodes.rationale: The package preserves identical inputs, one common prompt, immutable outputs, full logs, and an independent comparison so the experiment can be reproduced and audited.

nodes.label: Blind Test Integrity Manifest
nodes.rationale: SHA-256 hashes bind the prompt, catalog, documents, raw results, logs, and comparison to exact archived bytes.

nodes.label: Automatic Intake Status Query
nodes.rationale: The saved answer distinguished implemented inactive intake-resume work from missing production wiring and concluded that applying a TenderPlan mark did not yet automatically start analysis.

nodes.label: Manual File Intake Query
nodes.rationale: Current production had no user-facing manual upload; an inactive workflow was only a calibration fixture, while a protected form upload could become a thin front door into the existing pipeline.
